title: Surreal Desert Vision
description: Two vibrant green birds perch on a gnarled branch wrapped in a green vine that emerges from a blue cauldron overflowing with glowing blue liquid and golden leaves. In a cracked red desert landscape, two stylized female profile faces appear amid floating colorful blocks with letters, with a winding dirt road leading toward distant red mountains under a giant red ringed planet and pink flowing ribbons in a dark teal sky.
prompt: Surreal desert scene with two bright green birds perched on a twisted branch wrapped in a green vine growing from a large blue cauldron filled with glowing blue liquid and golden foliage. Two stylized female profile faces in pink and yellow with intricate hair patterns float among colorful blocks with letters. A winding dirt road cuts through cracked red earth toward red mountains. A massive red planet with glowing rings hangs in a dark teal sky with flowing pink ribbons. Vibrant colors, detailed textures, dreamlike atmosphere.
